effect: Charging the emergency battery completed the night-preparation goal. The result also clarified that a supplied fuel-cell backup can sustain essential systems through a dark spell.
reaction: The link back to the recovered array is satisfying, though I had not expected the mention of a fuel-cell backup.

mostWorthwhile.text: Getting the radio working was most worthwhile: Mara’s twelve-minute-old message made the distance from Earth tangible and gave me a reason to wonder what comes next.

leastWorthwhile.text: Straightening and mounting the antenna felt predictable, although the resulting message made the sequence worthwhile.

surprise.text: The twelve-minute-old transmission made the communication delay concrete, and I was curious about Mara’s eventual reply.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to the radio or preparing the cabin for night.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to hear Mara’s reply and learn how the expedition develops, though the combinations so far have been fairly straightforward.
